diagrams.title: Planner Hierarchy: recursive decomposition
diagrams.content:
flowchart TD
  project["PROJECT board (spec / PRD / BMAD)"]
  projDecompose["planning/project-decompose (type=feature)"]
  feature["FEATURE board (SPEC.md)"]
  featDecompose["planning/feature-decompose (type=goal)"]
  goal["GOAL card"]
  goalPlan["planning/plan or dag-sketch (type=task)"]
  tasks["TASKS DAG"]
  executors["executors: single / loop / team"]
  dependsOn["depends_on via message_id (sibling scope)"]
  checkpoint["human checkpoint between levels"]
  gates["child-count gates: NO_FEATURES/GOALS/DAG_SEEDED"]
  prdImport["planning/prd-import G3 (not built)"]

  project -->|"project-decompose"| projDecompose
  projDecompose --> feature
  feature -->|"feature-decompose"| featDecompose
  featDecompose --> goal
  goal -->|"goal planner"| goalPlan
  goalPlan --> tasks
  tasks --> executors
  projDecompose -.-> checkpoint
  featDecompose -.-> checkpoint
  dependsOn -.-> feature
  dependsOn -.-> goal
  dependsOn -.-> tasks
  gates -.-> projDecompose
  gates -.-> featDecompose
  gates -.-> goalPlan
  prdImport -.->|"posts type=feature + type=goal"| project
